installed_statements: CREATE TABLE account_album_state (account_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=0),snapshot_observed_at REAL CHECK(snapshot_observed_at IS NULL OR (typeof(snapshot_observed_at) IN ('integer','real') AND snapshot_observed_at BETWEEN -1.7976931348623157e308 AND 1.7976931348623157e308)),legacy_cohort_present INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(typeof(legacy_cohort_present)='integer' AND legacy_cohort_present IN (0,1)),legacy_cohort_observed_at REAL CHECK(legacy_cohort_observed_at IS NULL OR (typeof(legacy_cohort_observed_at) IN ('integer','real') AND legacy_cohort_observed_at BETWEEN -1.7976931348623157e308 AND 1.7976931348623157e308)),CHECK(legacy_cohort_present=1 OR legacy_cohort_observed_at IS NULL)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE account_albums (account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),album_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES albums(id),source TEXT NOT NULL,saved_at REAL CHECK(saved_at IS NULL OR (typeof(saved_at) IN ('integer','real') AND saved_at BETWEEN -1.7976931348623157e308 AND 1.7976931348623157e308)),PRIMARY KEY(account_id,album_id)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE account_auth_expirations (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 account_id INTEGER REFERENCES accounts(id),
 unresolved_account_id INTEGER CHECK(unresolved_account_id IS NULL OR (typeof(unresolved_account_id)='integer' AND unresolved_account_id>0)),
 label TEXT NOT NULL,
 CHECK((account_id IS NOT NULL AND unresolved_account_id IS NULL) OR (account_id IS NULL AND unresolved_account_id IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE accounts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  credential_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
  brand_account_id TEXT,
  is_master INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(typeof(is_master)='integer' AND is_master IN (0,1)),
  last_auth_ok REAL,
  active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(typeof(active)='integer' AND active IN (0,1)),
  UNIQUE(label)
)

CREATE TABLE action_backups (
 action_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES actions(id),
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
 filename TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(filename)>0),
 retained_filename TEXT,
 digest TEXT CHECK(digest IS NULL OR (length(digest)=64 AND digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
 bytes INTEGER CHECK(bytes IS NULL OR (typeof(bytes)='integer' AND bytes>0)),
 availability TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(availability IN ('verified','missing_historical')),
 PRIMARY KEY(action_id,position),
 UNIQUE(action_id,filename),
 CHECK((availability='verified' AND retained_filename IS NOT NULL AND digest IS NOT NULL AND bytes IS NOT NULL) OR
       (availability='missing_historical' AND retained_filename IS NULL AND digest IS NULL AND bytes IS NULL))
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE action_drafts (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES actions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 account_id INTEGER REFERENCES accounts(id),
 signature TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(revision)=32),
 updated_at REAL CHECK(updated_at IS NULL OR (typeof(updated_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(updated_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
 recovery_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
 recovery_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(recovery_digest)=64 AND recovery_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 recovery_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recovery_bytes)='integer' AND recovery_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216)
)

CREATE TABLE action_placement_handles (
 action_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES action_placement_intents(action_id),
 video_id_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(video_id_snapshot)>0),
 occurrence_handle_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(occurrence_handle_snapshot)>0),
 PRIMARY KEY(action_id,video_id_snapshot)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE action_placement_intents (
 action_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES actions(id),
 target_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 after_video_id_snapshot TEXT,
 handles_present INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(handles_present)='integer' AND handles_present IN (0,1)),
 FOREIGN KEY(target_id,action_id) REFERENCES action_targets(id,action_id)
)

CREATE TABLE action_placement_items (
 action_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES action_placement_intents(action_id),
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
 video_id_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(video_id_snapshot)>0),
 PRIMARY KEY(action_id,position)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE action_plan_resolutions (
 action_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES actions(id),
 list_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(list_kind IN ('additions','unresolved')),
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
 recording_id INTEGER REFERENCES recordings(id),
 unresolved_key TEXT,
 captured_identity_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_video_id_snapshot TEXT,
 target_video_id_snapshot TEXT,
 method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(method IN ('reuse','search','unresolved')),
 PRIMARY KEY(action_id,list_kind,position),
 CHECK((recording_id IS NOT NULL AND unresolved_key IS NULL) OR
       (recording_id IS NULL AND unresolved_key IS NOT NULL AND unresolved_key=captured_identity_key))
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE action_steps (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 action_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES actions(id),
 target_id INTEGER,
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
 operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation IN ('delete_playlist','restore_backup','restore_keeper','delete_copy','place_tracks','merge_plan')),
 phase TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(phase IN ('prepared','pending','uncertain','failed','creating','created','restoring','deleting','remote_complete','complete','cancelled')),
 outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('not_sent','unknown','confirmed_present','confirmed_absent','complete','conflict')),
 claim_token TEXT CHECK(claim_token IS NULL OR length(claim_token)=32),
 creation_marker TEXT,
 created_provider_id_snapshot TEXT,
 created_playlist_scope_id TEXT REFERENCES playlist_scopes(id),
 original_survived INTEGER CHECK(original_survived IS NULL OR (typeof(original_survived)='integer' AND original_survived IN (0,1))),
 observed_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(observed_status IN ('unrecorded','unknown','present')),
 backup_filename TEXT,
 backup_digest TEXT CHECK(backup_digest IS NULL OR (length(backup_digest)=64 AND backup_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
 backup_bytes INTEGER CHECK(backup_bytes IS NULL OR (typeof(backup_bytes)='integer' AND backup_bytes>0)),
 backup_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(backup_status IN ('none','verified','missing_historical')),
 updated_at REAL CHECK(updated_at IS NULL OR (typeof(updated_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(updated_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
 recovery_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
 recovery_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(recovery_digest)=64 AND recovery_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 recovery_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recovery_bytes)='integer' AND recovery_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216),
 FOREIGN KEY(target_id,action_id) REFERENCES action_targets(id,action_id),
 UNIQUE(action_id,position),
 CHECK((backup_status='none' AND backup_filename IS NULL AND backup_digest IS NULL AND backup_bytes IS NULL) OR
       (backup_status='verified' AND backup_filename IS NOT NULL AND backup_digest IS NOT NULL AND backup_bytes IS NOT NULL) OR
       (backup_status='missing_historical' AND backup_filename IS NOT NULL AND backup_digest IS NULL AND backup_bytes IS NULL)),
 CHECK(phase<>'uncertain' OR outcome='unknown'),
 CHECK(phase<>'complete' OR outcome='complete')
)

CREATE TABLE action_target_claims (
 account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
 playlist_scope_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES playlist_scopes(id),
 action_target_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 claim_token TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(claim_token)=32),
 lease_until REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(lease_until) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(lease_until)<=1.7976931348623157e308),
 PRIMARY KEY(account_id,playlist_scope_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(action_target_id,account_id,playlist_scope_id) REFERENCES action_targets(id,account_id,playlist_scope_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE action_targets (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 action_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES actions(id),
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
 role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('source','destination','keeper','deletion','recovery','placement')),
 account_id INTEGER REFERENCES accounts(id),
 unresolved_account_id INTEGER,
 playlist_scope_id TEXT REFERENCES playlist_scopes(id),
 provider_playlist_id_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(provider_playlist_id_snapshot)>0),
 membership_ref_id INTEGER REFERENCES playlist_membership_refs(id),
 unresolved_membership_ref_id INTEGER,
 resolution_reason TEXT CHECK(resolution_reason IS NULL OR resolution_reason IN ('missing_account','missing_membership','unrecorded_account','missing_scope','membership_snapshot_mismatch')),
 UNIQUE(action_id,role,position),
 UNIQUE(id,action_id),
 UNIQUE(id,account_id,playlist_scope_id),
 CHECK(account_id IS NULL OR unresolved_account_id IS NULL),
 CHECK(membership_ref_id IS NULL OR unresolved_membership_ref_id IS NULL),
 CHECK(account_id IS NOT NULL OR resolution_reason IS NOT NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE actions (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(kind))>0),
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft','planned','pending','executing','executed','failed','cancelled','delete_pending','delete_failed','undoing','undo_failed','undone')),
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(revision)=32),
 idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(idempotency_key)>0),
 intent_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(intent_digest)=64 AND intent_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 parent_action_id INTEGER REFERENCES actions(id),
 undo_of_action_id INTEGER REFERENCES actions(id),
 reviewed_draft_id INTEGER,
 reviewed_draft_revision TEXT,
 reviewed_draft_signature TEXT,
 execution_token TEXT CHECK(execution_token IS NULL OR length(execution_token)=32),
 execution_mode TEXT CHECK(execution_mode IS NULL OR execution_mode IN ('delete','merge','move','copy')),
 created_at REAL CHECK(created_at IS NULL OR (typeof(created_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(created_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
 executed_at REAL CHECK(executed_at IS NULL OR (typeof(executed_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(executed_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
 recovery_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
 recovery_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(recovery_digest)=64 AND recovery_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 recovery_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recovery_bytes)='integer' AND recovery_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216),
 CHECK(parent_action_id IS NULL OR parent_action_id<>id),
 CHECK(undo_of_action_id IS NULL OR undo_of_action_id<>id),
 CHECK((reviewed_draft_id IS NULL AND reviewed_draft_revision IS NULL AND reviewed_draft_signature IS NULL) OR
       (reviewed_draft_id IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_draft_revision IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_draft_signature IS NOT NULL))
)
CREATE TABLE album_alias_checks (first_id TEXT NOT NULL,second_id TEXT NOT NULL,checked_at REAL NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(first_id,second_id),CHECK(first_id<second_id))

CREATE TABLE album_alias_reconciliations (retired_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES albums(id),album_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES albums(id),comparison_digest TEXT NOT NULL,verified_at REAL NOT NULL,CHECK(retired_id<>album_id))

CREATE TABLE album_artists (album_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES albums(id),position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position>=0),artist_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES artists(id),credit TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(album_id,position),CONSTRAINT ck_album_artists_position CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0))

CREATE TABLE album_description_access (provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider='deepseek'),scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('host','credential')),credential_key TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('auth','balance','rate_limit','unavailable')),retry_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(retry_at) IN ('real','integer') AND abs(retry_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),updated_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(updated_at) IN ('real','integer') AND abs(updated_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),legacy_usage_id INTEGER REFERENCES legacy_album_description_usage(id),evidence_filename TEXT,evidence_digest TEXT,CHECK((evidence_filename IS NULL AND evidence_digest IS NULL) OR (evidence_filename IS NOT NULL AND length(evidence_filename)>0 AND evidence_digest IS NOT NULL AND length(evidence_digest)=64 AND evidence_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),CHECK((scope='host' AND credential_key='' AND status='unavailable') OR (scope='credential' AND length(credential_key)>0 AND status IN ('auth','balance','rate_limit'))),PRIMARY KEY(provider,scope,credential_key)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE album_descriptions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,request_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES album_description_requests(id),filename TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(filename)>0),format_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(format_version='album-description-1'),content_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(content_digest)=64 AND content_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider='deepseek'),model_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(model_version)>0),created_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_at) IN ('real','integer') AND abs(created_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308))

CREATE TABLE album_discovery_memberships (album_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES albums(id),found_at REAL,last_shown REAL,first_shown REAL,offered_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,legacy_offered_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,legacy_first_shown REAL,legacy_last_shown REAL,CONSTRAINT ck_album_discovery_memberships_offered_count CHECK(typeof(offered_count)='integer' AND offered_count>=0),CONSTRAINT ck_album_discovery_memberships_legacy_offered_count CHECK(typeof(legacy_offered_count)='integer' AND legacy_offered_count>=0),CONSTRAINT ck_album_discovery_memberships_found_at CHECK(found_at IS NULL OR (typeof(found_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(found_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),CONSTRAINT ck_album_discovery_memberships_first_shown CHECK(first_shown IS NULL OR (typeof(first_shown) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(first_shown)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),CONSTRAINT ck_album_discovery_memberships_last_shown CHECK(last_shown IS NULL OR (typeof(last_shown) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(last_shown)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),CONSTRAINT ck_album_discovery_memberships_legacy_first_shown CHECK(legacy_first_shown IS NULL OR (typeof(legacy_first_shown) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(legacy_first_shown)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),CONSTRAINT ck_album_discovery_memberships_legacy_last_shown CHECK(legacy_last_shown IS NULL OR (typeof(legacy_last_shown) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(legacy_last_shown)<=1.7976931348623157e308)))

CREATE TABLE album_feedback (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 account_id INTEGER REFERENCES accounts(id),
 album_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES albums(id),
 source_browse_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 response TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(response IN ('more','known','reject')),
 created_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(created_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),
 withdrawn_at REAL CHECK(withdrawn_at IS NULL OR (typeof(withdrawn_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(withdrawn_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
 opportunity_id TEXT,
 action_id TEXT,
 legacy_author_unknown INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(legacy_author_unknown IN (0,1)),
 CHECK((account_id IS NOT NULL AND legacy_author_unknown=0) OR (account_id IS NULL AND legacy_author_unknown=1)),
 CHECK(withdrawn_at IS NULL OR withdrawn_at>=created_at)
)

CREATE TABLE album_feedback_legacy_dismissals (
 account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),
 album_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES albums(id),
 dismissed_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(dismissed_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(dismissed_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),
 PRIMARY KEY(account_id,album_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE album_feedback_response_outbox (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    action_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(action_id)>0),
    opportunity_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(opportunity_id)>0),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('feedback','withdraw')),
    observed_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(observed_at) IN ('real','integer')
        AND abs(observed_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),
    option_id TEXT,
    feedback_kind TEXT,
    target_action_id TEXT,
    delivered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(delivered IN (0,1)
        AND (delivered=0 OR kind='withdraw')),
    CHECK((kind='feedback' AND option_id IS NOT NULL
        AND feedback_kind IS NOT NULL AND feedback_kind IN ('more','known','reject')
        AND target_action_id IS NULL)
        OR (kind='withdraw' AND option_id IS NULL AND feedback_kind IS NULL
            AND target_action_id IS NOT NULL AND length(target_action_id)>0)))

CREATE TABLE album_identity_evidence (kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(kind)>0),source_id TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,filename TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(filename)>0),content_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(content_digest)=64 AND content_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(byte_size)='integer' AND byte_size BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608),file_offset INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(file_offset)='integer' AND file_offset>=0),format_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(format_version='legacy-evidence-1'),archived_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch('subsec')),resolution_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(resolution_status IN ('resolved','unresolved')),album_id INTEGER REFERENCES albums(id),PRIMARY KEY(kind,source_id)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE album_item_observations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    album_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES albums(id),
    entry_id INTEGER REFERENCES catalog_entries(id),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(provider))>0),
    first_seen REAL,
    last_seen REAL,
    recording_id INTEGER REFERENCES recordings(id),
    raw_identity_key TEXT,
    legacy_row_id INTEGER UNIQUE,
    captured_position INTEGER,
    captured_disc_number INTEGER,
    captured_track_number INTEGER,
    CHECK(entry_id IS NOT NULL OR recording_id IS NOT NULL OR raw_identity_key IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK(first_seen IS NULL OR last_seen IS NULL OR first_seen<=last_seen)
)

CREATE TABLE album_menu_control_genres (
 singleton INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES album_menu_controls(singleton) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position BETWEEN 0 AND 99),
 genre_key TEXT REFERENCES genre_catalog(key),
 unresolved_value TEXT CHECK(unresolved_value IS NULL OR length(unresolved_value) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
 PRIMARY KEY(singleton,position),
 CHECK((genre_key IS NOT NULL AND unresolved_value IS NULL) OR (genre_key IS NULL AND unresolved_value IS NOT NULL))
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE album_menu_controls (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
 expires_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(expires_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(expires_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),
 novelty REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(novelty) IN ('integer','real') AND novelty BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
)

CREATE TABLE album_menu_refresh_exclusions (
    request_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 REFERENCES album_menu_refresh_state(id),
    position INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position BETWEEN 0 AND 99),
    browse_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(browse_id)='text' AND length(browse_id)>0),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider='youtube'),
    album_provider_id TEXT,
    unresolved_reason TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY(provider,album_provider_id) REFERENCES album_provider_ids(provider,provider_id),
    CHECK((album_provider_id IS NOT NULL AND album_provider_id=browse_id AND unresolved_reason IS NULL) OR
          (album_provider_id IS NULL AND unresolved_reason IS NOT NULL AND unresolved_reason='provider_album_not_admitted'))
)

CREATE TABLE album_menu_refresh_state (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
    epoch INTEGER CHECK(epoch IS NULL OR (typeof(epoch)='integer' AND epoch>=0)),
    updated_at REAL CHECK(updated_at IS NULL OR (typeof(updated_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(updated_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308))
)

CREATE TABLE album_note_outputs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK(id>=1),
    browse_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(typeof(browse_id)='text' AND length(browse_id)>0),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'youtube' CHECK(provider='youtube'),
    album_provider_id TEXT,
    unresolved_reason TEXT,
    filename TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(filename)='text' AND length(filename)>0),
    content_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(content_digest)=64 AND content_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(byte_size)='integer' AND byte_size BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576),
    built_at REAL CHECK(built_at IS NULL OR (typeof(built_at) IN ('real','integer') AND abs(built_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
    FOREIGN KEY(provider,album_provider_id) REFERENCES album_provider_ids(provider,provider_id),
    CHECK((album_provider_id IS NOT NULL AND album_provider_id=browse_id AND unresolved_reason IS NULL) OR
          (album_provider_id IS NULL AND unresolved_reason IS NOT NULL AND unresolved_reason='provider_album_not_admitted'))
)

CREATE TABLE album_note_requests (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK(id>=1),
    browse_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(typeof(browse_id)='text' AND length(browse_id)>0),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'youtube' CHECK(provider='youtube'),
    album_provider_id TEXT,
    unresolved_reason TEXT,
    artist TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(artist)='text' AND length(artist)>0),
    title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(title)='text' AND length(title)>0),
    year_text TEXT,
    year_number INTEGER CHECK(year_number IS NULL OR typeof(year_number)='integer'),
    thumbnail TEXT,
    requested_until REAL CHECK(requested_until IS NULL OR (typeof(requested_until) IN ('real','integer') AND abs(requested_until)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=1),
    requested_at REAL CHECK(requested_at IS NULL OR (typeof(requested_at) IN ('real','integer') AND abs(requested_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
    updated_at REAL CHECK(updated_at IS NULL OR (typeof(updated_at) IN ('real','integer') AND abs(updated_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)), work_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(typeof(work_revision)='integer' AND work_revision>=1),
    FOREIGN KEY(provider,album_provider_id) REFERENCES album_provider_ids(provider,provider_id),
    CHECK((album_provider_id IS NOT NULL AND album_provider_id=browse_id AND unresolved_reason IS NULL) OR
          (album_provider_id IS NULL AND unresolved_reason IS NOT NULL AND unresolved_reason='provider_album_not_admitted')),
    CHECK(year_text IS NULL OR year_number IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE album_occurrence_sources (
    occurrence_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES album_track_occurrences(id),
    entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_entries(id),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider IN ('youtube','local','unresolved')),
    PRIMARY KEY(occurrence_id,entry_id,provider)
)

CREATE TABLE album_playback_intent_items (
 intent_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES album_playback_intents(singleton) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
 video_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES youtube_items(video_id),
 PRIMARY KEY(intent_id,position)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE album_playback_intents (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
 account_id INTEGER REFERENCES accounts(id),
 album_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES albums(id),
 source_browse_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 playlist_scope_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES playlist_scopes(id),
 opportunity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 action_id TEXT,
 started_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(started_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(started_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),
 has_videos INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(has_videos IN (0,1)),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=1)
)

CREATE TABLE group_preparation_state (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
 fit_fingerprint TEXT,
 phase TEXT CHECK(phase IN ('preparing','ready','deferred')),
 reported_at REAL CHECK(reported_at IS NULL OR (typeof(reported_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(reported_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
 reason TEXT,
 generation_id INTEGER REFERENCES group_generations(id),
 unresolved_generation TEXT,
 input_serial INTEGER CHECK(input_serial IS NULL OR (typeof(input_serial)='integer' AND input_serial>=0)),
 checkpoint_at REAL CHECK(checkpoint_at IS NULL OR (typeof(checkpoint_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(checkpoint_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
 CHECK((phase IS NULL AND reported_at IS NULL AND reason IS NULL) OR (phase IS NOT NULL AND reported_at IS NOT NULL)),
 CHECK((generation_id IS NULL AND unresolved_generation IS NULL AND input_serial IS NULL AND checkpoint_at IS NULL)

CREATE TABLE group_retention_walk (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),revision INTEGER NOT NULL,phase TEXT NOT NULL,source INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,cursor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',cursor2 TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',cursor3 TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE recommendation_generations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,external_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(external_key)>0),policy_version TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recommendation_policies(version),group_generation_id INTEGER REFERENCES group_publications(generation_id),output_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(output_digest)=64 AND output_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),bundle_required INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(typeof(bundle_required)='integer' AND bundle_required IN (0,1)),input_revision INTEGER CHECK(input_revision IS NULL OR (typeof(input_revision)='integer' AND input_revision>=0)),revision_reason TEXT CHECK(revision_reason='legacy_not_recorded'),status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'building' CHECK(status IN ('building','ready','published','retiring')),created_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_at) IN ('real','integer') AND abs(created_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),published_at REAL CHECK(published_at IS NULL OR (typeof(published_at) IN ('real','integer') AND abs(published_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),CHECK((input_revision IS NOT NULL AND revision_reason IS NULL) OR (input_revision IS NULL AND revision_reason IS NOT NULL)),CHECK((status IN ('building','ready') AND published_at IS NULL) OR status='retiring' OR (status='published' AND published_at IS NOT NULL)))

CREATE TABLE recommendation_gradient_events (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  axis_id INTEGER REFERENCES taste_axes(id) NOT NULL,                 -- the facet that graduated, e.g. 'genre:techno'
  source     TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- the signal that drove it: 'play' | 'slider' | 'vibe' | 'like' | ...
  score      REAL NOT NULL,                 -- the ledger value at the crossing (what tripped THEME_THRESHOLD)
  factor     REAL NOT NULL,                 -- the nudge multiplier applied (graduate_up / graduate_down)
  new_weight REAL NOT NULL,                 -- the resulting permanent weight after the nudge
  created_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE recommendation_heads (surface TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(surface)>0),generation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(generation_id,surface) REFERENCES recommendation_generation_surfaces(generation_id,surface)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE recommendation_impression_policies (impression_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rec_served_impressions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('primary','pool')),raw_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(raw_version)='text'),policy_version TEXT REFERENCES recommendation_policies(version),resolution_reason TEXT CHECK(resolution_reason IN ('missing_policy','invalid_type')),PRIMARY KEY(impression_id,kind),CHECK((policy_version IS NOT NULL AND policy_version=raw_version AND resolution_reason IS NULL) OR (policy_version IS NULL AND resolution_reason IS NOT NULL))) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE recommendation_legacy_evidence (kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(kind)>0),source_id TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,filename TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(filename)>0),content_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(content_digest)=64 AND content_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(byte_size)='integer' AND byte_size BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608),file_offset INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(file_offset)='integer' AND file_offset>=0),format_version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(format_version='legacy-evidence-1'),archived_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch('subsec')),resolution_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(resolution_status IN ('resolved','unresolved')),recording_id INTEGER REFERENCES recordings(id),PRIMARY KEY(kind,source_id)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE recommendation_policies (version TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(version)>0),base_version TEXT REFERENCES recommendation_policy_bodies(version),configuration_filename TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(configuration_filename)>0),content_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(content_digest)=64 AND content_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(byte_size)='integer' AND byte_size>0 AND byte_size<=8388608),configuration_offset INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(configuration_offset)='integer' AND configuration_offset>=0),created_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_at) IN ('real','integer') AND abs(created_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),served INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(typeof(served)='integer' AND served IN (0,1))) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE recommendation_policy_bodies (version TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(version)>0),configuration_filename TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(configuration_filename)>0),content_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(content_digest)=64 AND content_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(byte_size)='integer' AND byte_size>0 AND byte_size<=8388608),configuration_offset INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(configuration_offset)='integer' AND configuration_offset>=0),created_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(created_at) IN ('real','integer') AND abs(created_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),served INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(typeof(served)='integer' AND served IN (0,1))) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE recommendation_policy_history (version TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(version)>0),created_at REAL NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('archived','expired'))) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE recommendation_pool_retirements (pool_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES recommendation_pools(id)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE recommendation_pool_revalidations (generation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES recommendation_generations(id),surface TEXT NOT NULL,mode_key TEXT NOT NULL,purpose TEXT NOT NULL,pool_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES recommendation_pools(id),policy_version TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recommendation_policies(version),PRIMARY KEY(generation_id,surface,mode_key,purpose)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE recommendation_pools (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,pool_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(pool_key)>0),policy_version TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recommendation_policies(version),group_version_id INTEGER REFERENCES group_versions(id),input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_fingerprint)=64 AND input_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),content_digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(content_digest)=64 AND content_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),purpose TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(purpose IN ('card','radio','ppr','vibe','temporal','fresh')),eligible_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(eligible_count)='integer' AND eligible_count>=0),complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(typeof(complete)='integer' AND complete IN (0,1)))

CREATE TABLE recommendation_radio_bands (pool_id INTEGER NOT NULL,recording_id INTEGER NOT NULL,intensity_band INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(intensity_band)='integer' AND intensity_band BETWEEN 0 AND 50),genre_key TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(pool_id,recording_id),FOREIGN KEY(pool_id,recording_id) REFERENCES recommendation_candidates(pool_id,recording_id)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE recommendation_report_files (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL CHECK(id>0),
    publication_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

    chunk_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(chunk_key=CAST(CAST(chunk_key AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) AND CAST(chunk_key AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 63),

CREATE TABLE recommendation_report_heads (
    surface TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    publication_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    FOREIGN KEY(publication_id,surface) REFERENCES recommendation_report_publications(id,surface)
) WITHOUT ROWID

    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL CHECK(id>0),

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'building' CHECK(status IN ('building','published','retiring')),
    built_at REAL CHECK(built_at IS NULL OR (typeof(built_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(built_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),

    schema_version INTEGER CHECK(schema_version IS NULL OR (typeof(schema_version)='integer' AND schema_version>=0)),
    watermark TEXT,
    report_key TEXT,

    has_content INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(has_content)='integer' AND has_content IN (0,1)),

CREATE TABLE recommendation_surface_pools (generation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,surface TEXT NOT NULL,mode_key TEXT NOT NULL,purpose TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(purpose)>0),pool_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES recommendation_pools(id),PRIMARY KEY(generation_id,surface,mode_key,purpose),FOREIGN KEY(generation_id,surface) REFERENCES recommendation_generation_surfaces(generation_id,surface)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE VIEW album_fetch_state AS
    SELECT a.id album_id,t.fetched_at,1 complete,t.expected_count expected_track_count
    FROM albums a JOIN album_tracklists t ON t.id=a.current_tracklist_id WHERE t.status='complete'
CREATE VIEW album_primary_provider_ids AS SELECT provider,provider_id,album_id FROM album_provider_ids WHERE is_primary=1

CREATE VIEW album_track_links AS
    SELECT min(t.id) id,p.provider_id browse_id,e.recording_id,t.entry_id,e.video_id,min(t.source) source
    FROM album_tracks t JOIN album_provider_ids p ON p.album_id=t.album_id AND p.provider='youtube'
    JOIN catalog_entries e ON e.id=t.entry_id GROUP BY p.provider_id,t.entry_id

CREATE VIEW album_tracklist_keys AS
    SELECT p.provider_id browse_id,a.title,a.artist,a.thumbnail,
        (SELECT json_group_array(k) FROM (SELECT coalesce(r.identity_key,o.raw_identity_key) k
         FROM album_track_occurrences o LEFT JOIN recordings r ON r.id=o.recording_id
         WHERE o.tracklist_id=t.id ORDER BY o.position IS NULL,o.position,o.id)) track_keys
    FROM albums a JOIN album_tracklists t ON t.id=a.current_tracklist_id
    JOIN album_provider_ids p ON p.album_id=a.id AND p.provider='youtube' WHERE t.status='complete'

CREATE VIEW album_tracks AS
    SELECT o.id,t.album_id,(SELECT min(s.entry_id) FROM album_occurrence_sources s WHERE s.occurrence_id=o.id) entry_id,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM album_occurrence_sources s WHERE s.occurrence_id=o.id) THEN NULL ELSE o.recording_id END recording_id,
           o.raw_identity_key legacy_track_key,o.position,o.disc_number,o.track_number,1 is_full,coalesce(o.captured_source,'full_fetch') source
    FROM albums a JOIN album_tracklists t ON t.id=a.current_tracklist_id JOIN album_track_occurrences o ON o.tracklist_id=t.id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT -i.id,i.album_id,i.entry_id,i.recording_id,i.raw_identity_key,i.captured_position,i.captured_disc_number,i.captured_track_number,0,i.provider
    FROM album_item_observations i WHERE NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM albums a JOIN album_track_occurrences o ON o.tracklist_id=a.current_tracklist_id
        JOIN album_occurrence_sources s ON s.occurrence_id=o.id WHERE a.id=i.album_id AND s.entry_id=i.entry_id)

CREATE VIEW discovered_albums AS SELECT p.provider_id browse_id,a.artist,a.title,a.year,a.thumbnail,m.found_at,m.last_shown,COALESCE((SELECT g.name FROM genre_catalog g WHERE g.key=a.genre_key),a.unresolved_genre) AS genre,m.first_shown,m.offered_count,m.legacy_offered_count,m.legacy_first_shown,m.legacy_last_shown,(SELECT artist_id FROM album_artists aa WHERE aa.album_id=a.id ORDER BY position LIMIT 1) artist_id FROM album_discovery_memberships m JOIN albums a ON a.id=m.album_id JOIN album_primary_provider_ids p ON p.album_id=a.id AND p.provider='youtube'

CREATE VIEW discovered_tracks AS SELECT c.*,c.mb_year year,d.found_at,d.first_shown,d.last_shown,d.offered_count,c.last_enriched_at last_enriched,(SELECT o.source_token FROM discovery_sources s JOIN discovery_origin_tokens o ON o.id=s.origin_id WHERE s.recording_id=d.recording_id ORDER BY s.first_found_at,o.source_token,s.id LIMIT 1) source_browse_id FROM discovery_memberships d JOIN catalog_tracks c ON c.id=d.entry_id

CREATE VIEW discovery_origin_tokens AS
 SELECT o.id,o.kind,o.account_id,
 CASE o.kind
   WHEN 'album' THEN (SELECT provider_id FROM album_primary_provider_ids WHERE album_id=o.album_id AND provider='youtube')
   WHEN 'radio' THEN 'radio:'||o.seed_video_id
   WHEN 'genre' THEN 'genre:'||o.genre_key
   WHEN 'artist' THEN 'artist:'||(SELECT min(provider_id) FROM artist_provider_ids WHERE artist_id=o.artist_id AND provider='youtube')
   WHEN 'artist_start' THEN 'artist_start:'||(SELECT min(provider_id) FROM artist_provider_ids WHERE artist_id=o.artist_id AND provider='youtube')
   WHEN 'spotify_export' THEN 'spotify_export:'||o.account_id
   WHEN 'legacy_unknown' THEN o.legacy_source_key
   ELSE o.kind END source_token
 FROM discovery_origins o

CREATE VIEW eligible_listening_evidence AS
        SELECT CASE WHEN o.capture_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'capture:'||o.capture_item_id
                    ELSE 'day:'||o.id END evidence_id,
               o.account_id,o.identity_key,o.recording_id,o.day,o.source,o.timezone,
               o.precision,o.last_observed_at observed_at,NULL event_id,0 is_generated
        FROM listening_observation_subjects o WHERE o.day IS NOT NULL AND (
            o.source<>'ytm_history' OR NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM play_event_subjects pe JOIN play_event_calendar c ON c.event_id=pe.id
                JOIN play_event_sources s ON s.event_id=pe.id
                WHERE pe.account_id=o.account_id AND pe.identity_key=o.identity_key
                  AND c.day=o.day AND pe.is_generated=1)
            OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM play_event_subjects pe JOIN play_event_calendar c ON c.event_id=pe.id
                JOIN play_event_sources s ON s.event_id=pe.id
                WHERE pe.account_id=o.account_id AND pe.identity_key=o.identity_key
                  AND c.day=o.day AND COALESCE(pe.is_generated,0)=0)
            OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM listening_observation_subjects independent
                WHERE independent.account_id=o.account_id AND independent.identity_key=o.identity_key
                  AND independent.day=o.day AND independent.source<>'ytm_history'))
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'event:'||pe.id||':'||s.source,pe.account_id,pe.identity_key,pe.recording_id,c.day,
               s.source,c.timezone,'exact_timestamp',pe.played_at,pe.id,COALESCE(pe.is_generated,0)
        FROM play_event_subjects pe JOIN play_event_calendar c ON c.event_id=pe.id
        JOIN play_event_sources s ON s.event_id=pe.id WHERE COALESCE(pe.is_generated,0)=0

CREATE VIEW enrichment_conflict AS SELECT c.id,e.id AS track_id,CASE c.field WHEN 'mb_year' THEN 'year' ELSE c.field END AS field,(SELECT json_group_array(json(candidate)) FROM (SELECT json_object('provider',COALESCE(o.legacy_source,d.provider),'value',CASE WHEN o.number_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.number_value ELSE o.text_value END) AS candidate FROM metadata_conflict_candidates p JOIN metadata_observations o ON o.id=p.observation_id LEFT JOIN metadata_deliveries d ON d.id=o.delivery_id WHERE p.conflict_id=c.id ORDER BY p.position,o.id)) AS candidates,CASE c.status WHEN 'user_resolved' THEN 1 WHEN 'provider_converged' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS resolved,CAST(CASE WHEN chosen.number_value IS NOT NULL THEN chosen.number_value ELSE chosen.text_value END AS TEXT) AS resolved_value,c.updated_at,COALESCE(c.recording_id,r.recording_id) AS recording_id,r.input_video_id,c.field_scope FROM metadata_conflicts c JOIN catalog_entries e ON e.id=c.entry_id OR e.recording_id=c.recording_id LEFT JOIN metadata_observations chosen ON chosen.id=c.selected_observation_id LEFT JOIN metadata_legacy_records r ON r.legacy_owner='enrichment_conflict' AND r.legacy_id=c.legacy_record_id

CREATE VIEW enrichment_log AS SELECT o.id,o.entry_id AS track_id,o.source_run_id AS run_id,COALESCE(o.legacy_source,d.provider) AS provider,CASE o.field WHEN 'mb_year' THEN 'year' ELSE o.field END AS field,CAST(CASE WHEN o.number_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.number_value ELSE o.text_value END AS TEXT) AS value,o.observed_at AS created_at,o.recording_id,o.input_video_id,o.field_scope FROM metadata_observations o LEFT JOIN metadata_deliveries d ON d.id=o.delivery_id WHERE o.origin IN ('provider','legacy_log')

CREATE VIEW entry_field_choices AS SELECT h.entry_id,h.field,json_quote(CASE WHEN o.number_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.number_value ELSE COALESCE((SELECT name FROM genre_catalog WHERE key=COALESCE((SELECT genre_key FROM genre_redirects WHERE retired_key=o.genre_key),o.genre_key)),o.text_value) END) AS value_json,o.legacy_source AS source FROM metadata_choice_heads h JOIN metadata_observations o ON o.id=h.observation_id WHERE o.value_kind<>'withdrawn'

CREATE VIEW item_field_sources AS SELECT s.entry_id,s.field,COALESCE(d.provider,o.legacy_source,s.legacy_source) AS source,s.selected_at FROM entry_metadata_selections s LEFT JOIN metadata_observations o ON o.id=s.observation_id LEFT JOIN metadata_deliveries d ON d.id=o.delivery_id

CREATE VIEW listening_activity AS
SELECT pe.account_id,pe.identity_key,pe.recording_id,c.day,pe.played_at at,
       'exact_timestamp' precision,pe.id event_id
FROM play_event_subjects pe JOIN play_event_calendar c ON c.event_id=pe.id
WHERE COALESCE(pe.is_generated,0)=0
UNION ALL
SELECT d.account_id,d.identity_key,d.recording_id,d.day,d.day_ts,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible_listening_evidence e
           WHERE e.account_id=d.account_id AND e.identity_key=d.identity_key AND e.day=d.day
           AND e.precision='calendar_day') THEN 'calendar_day' ELSE 'legacy_unknown' END,
       NULL FROM listening_days d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM play_event_subjects pe JOIN play_event_calendar c ON c.event_id=pe.id
    WHERE pe.account_id=d.account_id AND pe.identity_key=d.identity_key AND c.day=d.day
    AND COALESCE(pe.is_generated,0)=0)

CREATE VIEW listening_daily_items AS
SELECT account_id||':'||day||':'||identity_key rowid,account_id||':'||day snapshot_id,
       identity_key,recording_id,source,day,account_id,last_event_at,last_observed_at
FROM listening_days

CREATE VIEW listening_daily_snapshots AS
SELECT account_id||':'||day id,account_id,day_ts taken_at,day
FROM listening_days GROUP BY account_id,day

CREATE VIEW listening_day_counts AS
        SELECT identity_key,COUNT(*) plays FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT account_id,identity_key,day FROM eligible_listening_evidence
        ) GROUP BY identity_key

CREATE VIEW listening_days AS
SELECT account_id,identity_key,MIN(recording_id) recording_id,day,
       CAST(strftime('%s',day||' 12:00:00') AS REAL) day_ts,
       MAX(CASE WHEN event_id IS NOT NULL THEN observed_at END) last_event_at,
       MAX(observed_at) last_observed_at,
       CASE WHEN MIN(source)=MAX(source) THEN MIN(source) ELSE 'multiple' END source
FROM eligible_listening_evidence GROUP BY account_id,identity_key,day

CREATE VIEW listening_evidence AS
SELECT CASE WHEN capture_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'capture:'||capture_item_id ELSE 'day:'||id END evidence_id,
       account_id,identity_key,recording_id,day,source,timezone,
       precision,last_observed_at observed_at,NULL event_id,0 is_generated
FROM listening_observation_subjects WHERE day IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'event:'||pe.id||':'||s.source,pe.account_id,pe.identity_key,pe.recording_id,c.day,
       s.source,c.timezone,'exact_timestamp',pe.played_at,pe.id,COALESCE(pe.is_generated,0)
FROM play_event_subjects pe JOIN play_event_calendar c ON c.event_id=pe.id
JOIN play_event_sources s ON s.event_id=pe.id

CREATE VIEW listening_observation_subjects AS
 SELECT o.*,coalesce(r.identity_key,o.unresolved_subject_key) identity_key
 FROM listening_observations o LEFT JOIN recordings r ON r.id=o.recording_id

CREATE VIEW metadata_decisions AS SELECT o.id,o.entry_id,o.field,json_quote(CASE WHEN o.number_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.number_value ELSE o.text_value END) AS value_json,o.legacy_source AS source,o.observed_at AS chosen_at,o.legacy_reference AS legacy_ref FROM metadata_observations o WHERE o.origin IN ('user','legacy_choice') AND o.value_kind<>'withdrawn'

CREATE VIEW play_event_subjects AS
 SELECT p.*,coalesce(r.identity_key,p.unresolved_subject_key) identity_key
 FROM play_events p LEFT JOIN recordings r ON r.id=p.recording_id

CREATE VIEW playable_library_tracks AS SELECT t.* FROM tracks t JOIN (SELECT e.recording_id,MIN(e.id) entry_id FROM catalog_entries e JOIN library_memberships m ON m.entry_id=e.id JOIN youtube_items y ON y.video_id=e.video_id WHERE COALESCE(y.available,1)<>0 GROUP BY e.recording_id) playable ON playable.entry_id=t.id

CREATE VIEW playlist_tracks AS SELECT p.playlist_id,e.id track_id,p.position FROM playlist_items p JOIN catalog_entries e ON e.video_id=p.video_id UNION ALL SELECT playlist_id,entry_id,position FROM unresolved_playlist_items
CREATE VIEW quarantined_playlists AS SELECT id playlist_scope_id,'Generated' name FROM playlist_scopes WHERE origin='tuneconsole' AND adopted=0

CREATE VIEW recording_field_sources AS SELECT s.recording_id,s.field,COALESCE(d.provider,o.legacy_source,s.legacy_source) AS source,s.selected_at FROM recording_metadata_selections s LEFT JOIN metadata_observations o ON o.id=s.observation_id LEFT JOIN metadata_deliveries d ON d.id=o.delivery_id

CREATE VIEW recording_listening_artists AS
 SELECT DISTINCT e.recording_id,coalesce(r.artist_id,c.artist_id) artist_id
 FROM catalog_entries e JOIN entry_artists c ON c.entry_id=e.id
 LEFT JOIN artist_redirects r ON r.retired_id=c.artist_id
CREATE VIEW saved_album_memberships AS SELECT account_id,album_id,source,saved_at FROM account_albums UNION ALL SELECT NULL,album_id,source,saved_at FROM unattributed_album_memberships

CREATE VIEW saved_albums AS SELECT p.provider_id browse_id,a.title,a.artist,a.year,a.type,a.thumbnail FROM albums a JOIN album_primary_provider_ids p ON p.album_id=a.id AND p.provider='youtube' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM saved_album_memberships m WHERE m.album_id=a.id)
CREATE VIEW tracks AS SELECT c.* FROM catalog_tracks c JOIN library_memberships m ON m.entry_id=c.id

CREATE VIEW trend_first_play AS
 SELECT 'track' kind,r.identity_key id_key,
 CAST(julianday(min(s.day))-julianday('1970-01-01') AS INTEGER) first_day,
 min(s.exact_at) first_ts,'canonical_listening' source
 FROM (SELECT recording_id,first_exact_day day,first_exact_play_at exact_at FROM recording_listening_summary
       UNION ALL SELECT recording_id,first_observed_day,NULL FROM recording_listening_summary
       UNION ALL SELECT recording_id,first_legacy_unknown_day,NULL FROM recording_listening_summary) s
 JOIN recordings r ON r.id=s.recording_id WHERE s.day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.recording_id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'artist','@artist:'||s.artist_id,CAST(julianday(min(s.day))-julianday('1970-01-01') AS INTEGER),
 min(s.exact_at),'canonical_listening'
 FROM (SELECT artist_id,first_exact_day day,first_exact_play_at exact_at FROM artist_listening_summary
       UNION ALL SELECT artist_id,first_observed_day,NULL FROM artist_listening_summary
       UNION ALL SELECT artist_id,first_legacy_unknown_day,NULL FROM artist_listening_summary) s
 WHERE s.day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.artist_id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'track',identity_key,CAST(julianday(min(day))-julianday('1970-01-01') AS INTEGER),
 min(CASE WHEN precision='exact_timestamp' THEN at END),'unresolved_listening'
 FROM listening_activity WHERE recording_id IS NULL AND day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY identity_key

CREATE TRIGGER action_created_scope_insert BEFORE INSERT ON action_steps WHEN NEW.created_playlist_scope_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM playlist_scopes s JOIN action_targets t ON t.id=NEW.target_id WHERE s.id=NEW.created_playlist_scope_id AND s.provider_playlist_id=NEW.created_provider_id_snapshot AND (s.kind='shared' OR (s.kind='account' AND s.account_id=t.account_id))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Recovery creation scope disagrees with its target'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_created_scope_update BEFORE UPDATE ON action_steps WHEN NEW.created_playlist_scope_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM playlist_scopes s JOIN action_targets t ON t.id=NEW.target_id WHERE s.id=NEW.created_playlist_scope_id AND s.provider_playlist_id=NEW.created_provider_id_snapshot AND (s.kind='shared' OR (s.kind='account' AND s.account_id=t.account_id))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Recovery creation scope disagrees with its target'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_draft_owner_insert BEFORE INSERT ON action_drafts WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM actions a WHERE a.id=NEW.id AND a.kind='merge_draft' AND a.status='draft') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Mutable preparation requires its draft action'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_draft_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE ON action_drafts WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM actions a WHERE a.id=NEW.id AND a.kind='merge_draft' AND a.status='draft') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Mutable preparation requires its draft action'); END
CREATE TRIGGER action_history_delete BEFORE DELETE ON actions WHEN OLD.kind<>'merge_draft' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Action history is retained for recovery and links'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON actions WHEN NEW.id<>OLD.id OR NEW.kind<>OLD.kind OR NEW.idempotency_key<>OLD.idempotency_key OR NEW.intent_digest<>OLD.intent_digest OR NEW.parent_action_id IS NOT OLD.parent_action_id OR NEW.undo_of_action_id IS NOT OLD.undo_of_action_id OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR NEW.execution_mode IS NOT OLD.execution_mode OR (OLD.reviewed_draft_id IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.reviewed_draft_id IS NOT OLD.reviewed_draft_id OR NEW.reviewed_draft_revision IS NOT OLD.reviewed_draft_revision OR NEW.reviewed_draft_signature IS NOT OLD.reviewed_draft_signature)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Committed action identity and reviewed revision cannot change'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_reviewed_draft_insert BEFORE INSERT ON actions WHEN NEW.reviewed_draft_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM action_drafts d WHERE d.id=NEW.reviewed_draft_id AND d.revision=NEW.reviewed_draft_revision AND d.signature=NEW.reviewed_draft_signature) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Reviewed draft revision is no longer current'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_reviewed_draft_update BEFORE UPDATE ON actions WHEN NEW.reviewed_draft_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.reviewed_draft_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM action_drafts d WHERE d.id=NEW.reviewed_draft_id AND d.revision=NEW.reviewed_draft_revision AND d.signature=NEW.reviewed_draft_signature) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Reviewed draft revision is no longer current'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_status_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON actions WHEN NEW.status<>OLD.status AND NOT ((OLD.status='draft' AND NEW.status IN ('cancelled')) OR (OLD.status='planned' AND NEW.status IN ('executing','executed','delete_pending','delete_failed','failed','cancelled')) OR (OLD.status='pending' AND NEW.status IN ('executing','executed','failed','cancelled')) OR (OLD.status='executing' AND NEW.status IN ('executed','delete_pending','delete_failed','failed')) OR (OLD.status='executed' AND NEW.status IN ('undoing','delete_pending','delete_failed')) OR (OLD.status='delete_pending' AND NEW.status IN ('executed','delete_failed')) OR (OLD.status='delete_failed' AND NEW.status IN ('delete_pending','executed','undoing')) OR (OLD.status='undoing' AND NEW.status IN ('undo_failed','undone')) OR (OLD.status='undo_failed' AND NEW.status IN ('undoing')) OR (OLD.status='failed' AND NEW.status IN ('executing','cancelled'))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Invalid action status transition'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_step_backup BEFORE UPDATE ON action_steps WHEN OLD.backup_status='verified' AND (NEW.backup_status<>OLD.backup_status OR NEW.backup_digest IS NOT OLD.backup_digest OR NEW.backup_bytes IS NOT OLD.backup_bytes) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Committed backup content cannot change'); END
CREATE TRIGGER action_step_completion BEFORE UPDATE ON action_steps WHEN OLD.phase='complete' AND NEW.phase<>'complete' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A completed recovery step cannot reopen'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_step_creation BEFORE UPDATE ON action_steps WHEN (OLD.creation_marker IS NOT NULL AND NEW.creation_marker IS NOT OLD.creation_marker) OR (OLD.created_provider_id_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND NEW.created_provider_id_snapshot IS NOT OLD.created_provider_id_snapshot) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A committed recovery creation cannot change its marker or destination'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_step_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON action_steps WHEN NEW.action_id<>OLD.action_id OR NEW.target_id IS NOT OLD.target_id OR NEW.position<>OLD.position OR NEW.operation<>OLD.operation BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Committed action step identity cannot change'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_step_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON action_steps WHEN NEW.phase<>OLD.phase AND NOT ((OLD.phase='prepared' AND NEW.phase IN ('pending','cancelled')) OR (OLD.phase='pending' AND NEW.phase IN ('uncertain','failed','creating','created','restoring','deleting','remote_complete','complete','cancelled')) OR (OLD.phase='uncertain' AND NEW.phase IN ('failed','remote_complete','complete','restoring')) OR (OLD.phase='failed' AND NEW.phase IN ('pending','uncertain','deleting','restoring','creating','created','remote_complete','complete','cancelled')) OR (OLD.phase='creating' AND NEW.phase IN ('pending','created','failed','remote_complete')) OR (OLD.phase='created' AND NEW.phase IN ('restoring','remote_complete','complete')) OR (OLD.phase='restoring' AND NEW.phase IN ('remote_complete','failed','complete')) OR (OLD.phase='deleting' AND NEW.phase IN ('failed','remote_complete','complete')) OR (OLD.phase='remote_complete' AND NEW.phase IN ('complete'))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Invalid action step transition'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_target_agreement_insert BEFORE INSERT ON action_targets WHEN (NEW.playlist_scope_id IS NOT NULL AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM playlist_scopes s WHERE s.id=NEW.playlist_scope_id AND s.provider_playlist_id=NEW.provider_playlist_id_snapshot AND ((s.kind='shared' AND s.account_id IS NULL) OR (s.kind='account' AND s.account_id=NEW.account_id))))) OR (NEW.membership_ref_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM playlist_membership_refs m WHERE m.id=NEW.membership_ref_id AND m.playlist_scope_id IS NEW.playlist_scope_id AND m.account_id IS NEW.account_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Action target disagrees with its account, scope or membership'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_target_agreement_update BEFORE UPDATE ON action_targets WHEN (NEW.playlist_scope_id IS NOT NULL AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM playlist_scopes s WHERE s.id=NEW.playlist_scope_id AND s.provider_playlist_id=NEW.provider_playlist_id_snapshot AND ((s.kind='shared' AND s.account_id IS NULL) OR (s.kind='account' AND s.account_id=NEW.account_id))))) OR (NEW.membership_ref_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM playlist_membership_refs m WHERE m.id=NEW.membership_ref_id AND m.playlist_scope_id IS NEW.playlist_scope_id AND m.account_id IS NEW.account_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Action target disagrees with its account, scope or membership'); END

CREATE TRIGGER recommendation_impression_link_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON recommendation_impression_policies WHEN NEW.impression_id IS NOT OLD.impression_id OR NEW.kind IS NOT OLD.kind OR NEW.raw_version IS NOT OLD.raw_version OR (OLD.policy_version IS NOT NULL AND NEW.policy_version IS NOT OLD.policy_version) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Impression policy ownership is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE action_backups (
 action_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES actions(id),
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
 filename TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(filename)>0),
 retained_filename TEXT,
 digest TEXT CHECK(digest IS NULL OR (length(digest)=64 AND digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
 bytes INTEGER CHECK(bytes IS NULL OR (typeof(bytes)='integer' AND bytes>0)),
 availability TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(availability IN ('verified','missing_historical')),
 PRIMARY KEY(action_id,position),
 UNIQUE(action_id,filename),
 CHECK((availability='verified' AND retained_filename IS NOT NULL AND digest IS NOT NULL AND bytes IS NOT NULL) OR
       (availability='missing_historical' AND retained_filename IS NULL AND digest IS NULL AND bytes IS NULL))
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE action_drafts (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES actions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 account_id INTEGER REFERENCES accounts(id),
 signature TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(revision)=32),
 updated_at REAL CHECK(updated_at IS NULL OR (typeof(updated_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(updated_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
 recovery_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
 recovery_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(recovery_digest)=64 AND recovery_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 recovery_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recovery_bytes)='integer' AND recovery_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216)
)

CREATE TABLE action_placement_handles (

 PRIMARY KEY(action_id,video_id_snapshot)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE action_placement_intents (

 FOREIGN KEY(target_id,action_id) REFERENCES action_targets(id,action_id)
)

CREATE TABLE action_placement_items (

) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE action_plan_resolutions (

 list_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(list_kind IN ('additions','unresolved')),
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
 recording_id INTEGER REFERENCES recordings(id),

 target_video_id_snapshot TEXT,
 method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(method IN ('reuse','search','unresolved')),
 PRIMARY KEY(action_id,list_kind,position),

       (recording_id IS NULL AND unresolved_key IS NOT NULL AND unresolved_key=captured_identity_key))
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE action_steps (

 target_id INTEGER,
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
 operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation IN ('delete_playlist','restore_backup','restore_keeper','delete_copy','place_tracks','merge_plan')),
 phase TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(phase IN ('prepared','pending','uncertain','failed','creating','created','restoring','deleting','remote_complete','complete','cancelled')),
 outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('not_sent','unknown','confirmed_present','confirmed_absent','complete','conflict')),
 claim_token TEXT CHECK(claim_token IS NULL OR length(claim_token)=32),
 creation_marker TEXT,
 created_provider_id_snapshot TEXT,
 created_playlist_scope_id TEXT REFERENCES playlist_scopes(id),
 original_survived INTEGER CHECK(original_survived IS NULL OR (typeof(original_survived)='integer' AND original_survived IN (0,1))),
 observed_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(observed_status IN ('unrecorded','unknown','present')),
 backup_filename TEXT,
 backup_digest TEXT CHECK(backup_digest IS NULL OR (length(backup_digest)=64 AND backup_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
 backup_bytes INTEGER CHECK(backup_bytes IS NULL OR (typeof(backup_bytes)='integer' AND backup_bytes>0)),
 backup_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(backup_status IN ('none','verified','missing_historical')),
 updated_at REAL CHECK(updated_at IS NULL OR (typeof(updated_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(updated_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
 recovery_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
 recovery_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(recovery_digest)=64 AND recovery_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 recovery_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recovery_bytes)='integer' AND recovery_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216),
 FOREIGN KEY(target_id,action_id) REFERENCES action_targets(id,action_id),
 UNIQUE(action_id,position),
 CHECK((backup_status='none' AND backup_filename IS NULL AND backup_digest IS NULL AND backup_bytes IS NULL) OR
       (backup_status='verified' AND backup_filename IS NOT NULL AND backup_digest IS NOT NULL AND backup_bytes IS NOT NULL) OR
       (backup_status='missing_historical' AND backup_filename IS NOT NULL AND backup_digest IS NULL AND backup_bytes IS NULL)),
 CHECK(phase<>'uncertain' OR outcome='unknown'),
 CHECK(phase<>'complete' OR outcome='complete')
)

CREATE TABLE album_feedback_legacy_dismissals (

 album_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES albums(id),

 PRIMARY KEY(account_id,album_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE album_feedback_response_outbox (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    action_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(action_id)>0),
    opportunity_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(opportunity_id)>0),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('feedback','withdraw')),
    observed_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(observed_at) IN ('real','integer')
        AND abs(observed_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),
    option_id TEXT,

    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

    entry_id INTEGER REFERENCES catalog_entries(id),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(provider))>0),
    first_seen REAL,
    last_seen REAL,
    recording_id INTEGER REFERENCES recordings(id),

    legacy_row_id INTEGER UNIQUE,
    captured_position INTEGER,
    captured_disc_number INTEGER,
    captured_track_number INTEGER,
    CHECK(entry_id IS NOT NULL OR recording_id IS NOT NULL OR raw_identity_key IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK(first_seen IS NULL OR last_seen IS NULL OR first_seen<=last_seen)
)

CREATE TABLE album_menu_control_genres (
 singleton INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES album_menu_controls(singleton) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position BETWEEN 0 AND 99),
 genre_key TEXT REFERENCES genre_catalog(key),
 unresolved_value TEXT CHECK(unresolved_value IS NULL OR length(unresolved_value) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
 PRIMARY KEY(singleton,position),
 CHECK((genre_key IS NOT NULL AND unresolved_value IS NULL) OR (genre_key IS NULL AND unresolved_value IS NOT NULL))

CREATE TABLE album_menu_controls (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
 expires_at REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(expires_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(expires_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308),
 novelty REAL NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(novelty) IN ('integer','real') AND novelty BETWEEN 0 AND 1)

    request_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 REFERENCES album_menu_refresh_state(id),
    position INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position BETWEEN 0 AND 99),
    browse_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(browse_id)='text' AND length(browse_id)>0),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider='youtube'),
    album_provider_id TEXT,
    unresolved_reason TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY(provider,album_provider_id) REFERENCES album_provider_ids(provider,provider_id),
    CHECK((album_provider_id IS NOT NULL AND album_provider_id=browse_id AND unresolved_reason IS NULL) OR
          (album_provider_id IS NULL AND unresolved_reason IS NOT NULL AND unresolved_reason='provider_album_not_admitted'))

CREATE TABLE album_menu_refresh_state (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
    epoch INTEGER CHECK(epoch IS NULL OR (typeof(epoch)='integer' AND epoch>=0)),
    updated_at REAL CHECK(updated_at IS NULL OR (typeof(updated_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(updated_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308))
)

CREATE TABLE album_note_outputs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK(id>=1),
    browse_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(typeof(browse_id)='text' AND length(browse_id)>0),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'youtube' CHECK(provider='youtube'),

          (album_provider_id IS NULL AND unresolved_reason IS NOT NULL AND unresolved_reason='provider_album_not_admitted'))

    album_provider_id TEXT,
    unresolved_reason TEXT,
    artist TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(artist)='text' AND length(artist)>0),
    title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(title)='text' AND length(title)>0),

    thumbnail TEXT,

    PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,position)

    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    album_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES albums(id),
    tracklist_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    captured_provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at REAL,
    FOREIGN KEY(tracklist_id,album_id) REFERENCES album_tracklists(id,album_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
    UNIQUE(id,tracklist_id)
)

CREATE TABLE album_track_occurrences (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    tracklist_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES album_tracklists(id),
    position INTEGER CHECK(position IS NULL OR (typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0)),
    disc_number INTEGER CHECK(disc_number IS NULL OR (typeof(disc_number)='integer' AND disc_number>0)),
    track_number INTEGER CHECK(track_number IS NULL OR (typeof(track_number)='integer' AND track_number>0)),
    recording_id INTEGER REFERENCES recordings(id),
    captured_title TEXT,
    captured_credit TEXT,
    raw_identity_key TEXT,
    raw_source_ref TEXT,
    captured_source TEXT,
    resolution_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(resolution_status IN ('resolved','unresolved','unavailable')),
    legacy_row_id INTEGER UNIQUE,
    CHECK((recording_id IS NOT NULL AND resolution_status='resolved') OR (recording_id IS NULL AND resolution_status IN ('unresolved','unavailable'))),
    UNIQUE(tracklist_id,position),
    UNIQUE(id,tracklist_id)
)

CREATE TABLE album_tracklists (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    album_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES albums(id),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>0),
    capture_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(capture_kind IN ('provider','legacy_full','legacy_share','share')),
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('building','partial','complete','snapshot')),
    order_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(order_status IN ('known','unknown','mixed')),
    expected_count INTEGER CHECK(expected_count IS NULL OR (typeof(expected_count)='integer' AND expected_count>=0)),
    fetched_at REAL CHECK(fetched_at IS NULL OR (typeof(fetched_at) IN ('integer','real') AND fetched_at BETWEEN -1.7976931348623157e308 AND 1.7976931348623157e308)),
    CHECK((status<>'snapshot' OR capture_kind IN ('legacy_share','share')) AND (status<>'complete' OR capture_kind IN ('provider','legacy_full'))),
    FOREIGN KEY(provider,provider_id) REFERENCES album_provider_ids(provider,provider_id),
    UNIQUE(provider,provider_id,revision),
    UNIQUE(id,album_id)
)

CREATE TABLE rec_feedback (
  surface TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- where it happened: 'for_you', 'suggest', 'discover'
  item_key TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- track identity_key (or 'artist:<name>' for a mute)
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- 'dismiss' | 'less' | 'more' | 'mute' | 'not_now'
  reason TEXT,                            -- optional axis/reason ('era','artist','vibe','own_it')
  scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',         -- '' = global; else a playlist id for playlist-local
  until REAL,                             -- suppressed until ts (NULL = until explicitly cleared)
  created_at REAL, target_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_unresolved', recording_id INTEGER REFERENCES recordings(id), artist_id INTEGER REFERENCES artists(id),
  PRIMARY KEY (surface, item_key, scope)
)
CREATE TABLE rec_group_clock (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),serial INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE rec_impressions (
  surface TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 'for_you' | 'explore' | 'suggest'
  item_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  views INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- times shown (debounced), for anti-staleness erosion
  last_shown REAL,                        -- drives the recycle cooldown
  PRIMARY KEY (surface, item_key)
)

CREATE TABLE rec_lane_impressions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  lane TEXT NOT NULL,                      -- #87 which home lane served the item
  identity_key TEXT NOT NULL,              -- what was shown (future lane-bandit success join)
  at REAL NOT NULL
, recording_id INTEGER REFERENCES recordings(id), raw_identity_key TEXT)

CREATE TABLE rec_lean (
  axis_id INTEGER REFERENCES taste_axes(id) PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,                  -- 'genre:<fam>' | 'genre:<sub>' | 'era:<decade>' | 'artist:<name>'
  value REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,        -- standing transient multiplier; 1.0 = neutral (non-decaying)
  updated_at REAL,                        -- when the slider was last moved (drives held-day exposure)
  last_graduated_day TEXT                 -- UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) of last exposure-graduation, or NULL
)

CREATE TABLE rec_mode_impressions (epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,lane TEXT NOT NULL,mode_id INTEGER REFERENCES taste_modes(mode_id),ranker TEXT,created_at REAL NOT NULL,legacy_mode_id INTEGER,CHECK((mode_id IS NOT NULL)<>(legacy_mode_id IS NOT NULL)),PRIMARY KEY(epoch,lane))

CREATE TABLE rec_mode_picks (membership_ref_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES playlist_membership_refs(id),mode_id INTEGER REFERENCES taste_modes(mode_id),ranker TEXT,created_at REAL NOT NULL,legacy_mode_id INTEGER,CHECK((mode_id IS NOT NULL)<>(legacy_mode_id IS NOT NULL)))

CREATE TABLE rec_model_forecasts (
  run_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rec_model_selection_runs(id),
  made_at REAL NOT NULL,
  forecast_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, made_at)
)

CREATE TABLE rec_model_previous_vectors (
  run_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES rec_model_selection_runs(id),
  identity_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  vec BLOB NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, identity_key)
)

CREATE TABLE rec_model_selection_runs (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  started_at REAL NOT NULL,
  result_json TEXT NOT NULL
, identity_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

CREATE TABLE rec_musical_links (source_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rec_musical_sources(source_key),recording_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings(id),delivery_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(source_key,recording_id))

CREATE TABLE rec_musical_pending (position INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,source_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,cursor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,CONSTRAINT ck_rec_musical_pending_position CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),CONSTRAINT ck_rec_musical_pending_revision CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=1),CONSTRAINT ck_rec_musical_pending_cursor CHECK(typeof(cursor)='integer' AND cursor>=0))
CREATE TABLE rec_musical_profiles (identity_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,version TEXT NOT NULL,digest TEXT NOT NULL,prepared_at REAL NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE rec_musical_source_profiles (source_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,version TEXT NOT NULL,digest TEXT NOT NULL,prepared_at REAL NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE rec_musical_sources (source_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,provider TEXT NOT NULL,scope TEXT NOT NULL,entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
CREATE TABLE rec_preparation (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),content_changes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,evidence_changes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE rec_proposals (
  surface TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,               -- 'fresh_songs' | 'discover'
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- JSON, materialized by the rec worker (last-good serving)
  built_at REAL
)

CREATE TABLE rec_recipes (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  playlist_scope_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES playlist_scopes(id),
  revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(revision)=32),
  created_at REAL CHECK(created_at IS NULL OR (typeof(created_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(created_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),
  media TEXT CHECK(media IS NULL OR media IN ('audio','video')),
  model TEXT,
  journey TEXT,
  opportunity_id TEXT,
  option_id TEXT,
  recovery_filename TEXT NOT NULL,
  recovery_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(recovery_digest)=64 AND recovery_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  recovery_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recovery_bytes)='integer' AND recovery_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 16777216)
)

CREATE TABLE rec_response_events (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, event_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        identity_key TEXT NOT NULL, at REAL NOT NULL, is_generated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        UNIQUE(event_id, kind, identity_key)
    ,CONSTRAINT ck_rec_response_events_is_generated CHECK(typeof(is_generated)='integer' AND is_generated IN (0,1)))

CREATE TABLE rec_served_impressions (
  id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  request_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
  surface           TEXT NOT NULL,
  lane              TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode_id           INTEGER,
  identity_key      TEXT NOT NULL,
  rank               INTEGER NOT NULL,
  score              REAL,
  model_version      TEXT NOT NULL,
  provenance         TEXT NOT NULL,
  served_at          REAL NOT NULL, recording_id INTEGER REFERENCES recordings(id), raw_identity_key TEXT,
  UNIQUE(request_id, surface, rank)
,CONSTRAINT ck_rec_served_impressions_rank CHECK(typeof(rank)='integer' AND rank>=0),CONSTRAINT ck_rec_served_impressions_score CHECK(score IS NULL OR (typeof(score) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(score)<=1.7976931348623157e308)),CONSTRAINT ck_rec_served_impressions_served_at CHECK(typeof(served_at) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(served_at)<=1.7976931348623157e308))

CREATE TABLE rec_theme (
  axis_id INTEGER REFERENCES taste_axes(id) PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,             -- 'genre:<fam>' | 'era:<decade>' | 'artist:<name>'
  score      REAL NOT NULL,                -- persistent signed running total (interaction-driven, no time decay)
  updated_at REAL NOT NULL                 -- bookkeeping only
)

CREATE TABLE rec_vibe_pending (position INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,group_key TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,cursor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',CONSTRAINT ck_rec_vibe_pending_position CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),CONSTRAINT ck_rec_vibe_pending_revision CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=1))

  axis_id INTEGER REFERENCES taste_axes(id) PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,                  -- e.g. 'lane:deep_cut', 'family:techno'

  updated_at REAL                         -- #85 last nudge time; drives time-proportional reversion at read
)

CREATE TABLE recipe_artists (
 recipe_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES road_trip_recipes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 artist_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES artists(id),
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
 PRIMARY KEY(recipe_id,artist_id), UNIQUE(recipe_id,position)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE recipe_genres (
 recipe_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES road_trip_recipes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 genre_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES genre_catalog(key),
 role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('include','exclude')),
 position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(position)='integer' AND position>=0),
 PRIMARY KEY(recipe_id,genre_key,role), UNIQUE(recipe_id,role,position)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE recipe_unresolved_artists (
 recipe_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES road_trip_recipes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

 reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reason='unknown_or_ambiguous_artist'),

) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE recipe_unresolved_genres (
 recipe_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES road_trip_recipes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('include','exclude')),

 raw_label TEXT NOT NULL,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reason IN ('unknown_genre','ambiguous_genre')),
 PRIMARY KEY(recipe_id,role,position)
) WITHOUT ROWID
